candidate_workaround: Retain the timeout, disable profile startup for the read, extend the wrapper to sixty seconds, and read the unchanged file through EOF.
failure_signature: A complete required-skill read exceeds a ten-second shell wrapper before any content returns.
recurrence_guard: Do not repeat the same short wrapper; use the observed no-profile startup envelope for required full reads.
rollback: Stop the read, retain the failure, and leave repository and external state unchanged.
scope_boundary: Preferred only for bounded local instruction reads; it grants no scientific, professional, authority, production, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: No-profile bounded full skill read after short-wrapper timeout
trigger_preconditions: A required local instruction file remains unread after a bounded short-wrapper timeout.
